Overview & Sources

Where cosmetics come from and why they matter
Cosmetic Power Layer

Cosmetics are collection items, identity pieces, and a world-behavior reference.

Archlight currently centers cosmetics around Abaldar and Legacy. Abaldar treats cosmetics as visual heirloom/carry-over rewards without gameplay bonuses, while Legacy keeps long-term cosmetics, merged Ildar/Dracona history, heirlooms, and bonus-enabled cosmetics where that system applies. Each card now separates acquisition from current world behavior so players can understand both the source and the practical meaning.

AbaldarVisual heirloom/carry-over. Race cosmetics can be visual on Abaldar.
LegacyLong-term home for merged Ildar/Dracona cosmetics, heirlooms, and bonus-enabled cosmetics.
Cross-serverShown only when the source supports Abaldar ↔ Legacy behavior.
